svg.title: Interface designer — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as interface designer, wearing a plain work shirt. Visible work cue: Two-part interface wireframe with a large selection pointer, leaving clear space around the pointer. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: side-swept hair, a tapered face and round glasses.
